datagate.blurb: An HTTP service that ingests remote CSV files and serves them back as JSON. Seven checkpoints.

titles.01-datagate-clarified.patch: Encoding fallback, rowid origin, upload charset, spreadsheet charset, force value
titles.03-datagate-delimiter-if-present.patch: Delimiter inference only when a delimiter is present

file_merger.blurb: A command-line tool that merges CSV, TSV, JSONL and Parquet inputs into one schema-resolved CSV. Four checkpoints.

titles.01-tsv-crlf.patch: TSV lines may end in CRLF
titles.02-authoritative-typed-sources.patch: JSONL ranks equal to CSV under the authoritative strategy
titles.04-map-key-quoted.patch: Map keys in field paths are double-quoted
titles.06-alias-cycle-at-load.patch: Alias cycles are detected when the alias file loads
titles.07-partition-encode-value-only.patch: Percent-encoding applies to the partition value only
titles.08-map-key-unquoted-is-error.patch: An unquoted map key is a syntax error

xjq.blurb: A command-line XPath and CSS query tool for XML and HTML, with JSON conversion. Five checkpoints.

titles.01-text-flags-per-element.patch: Text flags yield one result per matched element
titles.02-no-trailing-newline.patch: No trailing newline after the last text result
titles.03-empty-string-text.patch: The empty string keeps an empty text node
titles.04-union-mixed-results-as-text.patch: A union with mixed result types is written as text

mvvault.blurb: A command-line tool that keeps local vaults of media-platform metadata, tracks field history by sync timestamp, and serves a web viewer. Six checkpoints.

rejector.blurb: A command-line tool that sends prompts from a YAML task config to a chat completions API under rate limits, with sampling, judging and agentic loops. Five checkpoints.
